entries.text: The ClickHouse TPC-H and SSB tuned templates now carry measured-benefit evidence states. At SF1 on ClickHouse 25.8.33.6 in a 5.25 GiB container the TPC-H template has a geometric mean ratio of 0.8230 (95% interval 0.7803 to 0.8777) against notuning and the SSB template 0.7484 (0.7258 to 0.7881). The ClickHouse TPC-DS template stays unmeasured: the cell was killed by the memory-pressure watchdog on every attempt. The tuning evidence harness now reads the query id the ClickHouse adapter actually sent, so rows read, bytes read and peak memory are reported per query.
